challenges.name: 6-Week Macro Tracking
challenges.description: A 6-week challenge to hit daily macro targets every single day. Requires tracking protein, carbs, and fat using a food app (MyFitnessPal, Cronometer, etc.). No off days — 42 days of consistent logging.
challenges.goal: Hit your daily macro targets 6 out of 7 days every week for 6 weeks
challenges.macro_targets_note: Set your personal targets in your tracking app based on your goal (cut/maintain/bulk)

task.habit: Track and hit your macro targets today

targets.carbs_g: Set in your app based on activity level
targets.fat_g: Set in your app (0.8–1.2g per kg bodyweight)
targets.calories: Set based on goal: deficit for cut, surplus for bulk

rules: Log every meal before eating when possible
Weigh food with a kitchen scale for accuracy
Log a 'cheat' meal honestly — don't skip it
